description: This file contains utility functions for manipulating and querying argparse.ArgumentParser objects, such as checking if an argument is in a group, removing arguments, retrieving choices, and setting custom attributes.

methods.name: bool in_group(parser: ArgumentParser, argument_name: str, group_title: str)
methods.description: Checks if a given argument is part of a specified argument group within an ArgumentParser.

methods.name: List[Optional[str]] remove_argument(parser: ArgumentParser, argument_name: str)
methods.description: Removes a specific argument from the ArgumentParser and associated groups.

methods.name: Tuple get_argument_choices(parser: ArgumentParser, argument_name: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the list of choices for a specific argument in the parser.

methods.name: bool get_argument_optional_choices(parser: ArgumentParser, argument_name: str)
methods.description: Returns the 'optional_choices' attribute of an argument if it exists.

methods.name: set_optional_choices(action: Action, optional_choices: bool)
methods.description: Sets a custom attribute 'optional_choices' on an argparse Action.

ctags.name: in_group
ctags.pattern: /^def in_group(parser: ArgumentParser, argument_name: str, group_title: str) -> bool:$/
